subject.title: Feature: Support Telegram media groups (albums) in message tool

question: Should maintainers adopt/port the open draft fork PR's explicit send-media-group action, or implement album grouping through the existing mediaUrls/reply payload paths instead?
rationale: Both approaches add user-facing Telegram action semantics, and the open candidate is a draft fork PR, so automation should not choose the permanent tool/API shape or close the issue before maintainer review.

options.title: Port album support into existing mediaUrls paths
options.body: Implement sendMediaGroup for eligible Telegram mediaUrls in the existing action, reply, and outbound delivery funnels, with sequential fallback for non-groupable cases.

options.title: Adopt the explicit fork action
options.body: Review and update the open draft fork PR if maintainers prefer a separate send-media-group action and filePaths-style parameter surface.

options.title: Defer native albums
options.body: Keep current sequential sends and close/supersede the draft PR only if maintainers decide native Telegram albums are not wanted now.

recommendation.title: Port album support into existing mediaUrls paths
recommendation.body: Implement sendMediaGroup for eligible Telegram mediaUrls in the existing action, reply, and outbound delivery funnels, with sequential fallback for non-groupable cases.

likelyOwner.reason: This owner already reviewed the issue and has recent history on the Telegram action media surface and product-sensitive channel boundary.
